organization_id.description: Organization tenant that owns this role assignment.

organization_membership_id.description: OrganizationMembership record for the person receiving this role.

organization_role_id.description: OrganizationRole record assigned to this membership.

is_active.description: Controls whether this role assignment currently grants permissions.

assigned_at.description: ISO timestamp when the role was assigned.

assigned_by.description: User ID of the person or platform process that assigned the role.

revoked_at.description: ISO timestamp when this role assignment was ended, if applicable.

revoked_by.description: User ID of the person or platform process that ended this role assignment.
